# CMake build for the BEAGLE Metal backend (macOS only).
#
# Requires:
#   - macOS 12+ (Monterey) for MTLLanguageVersion2_3
#   - Apple Silicon or AMD/Intel GPU that supports Metal
#   - Xcode 13+ toolchain
#
# The Metal kernel source strings (BeagleMetal_kernels.h) are generated by
# running   make_metal_kernels.sh   from the kernels/ directory.  The custom
# command below regenerates them automatically during the build if any of the
# kernel source files change.

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Kernel source generation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../kernels/BeagleMetal_kernels.h
    COMMAND bash ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../kernels/make_metal_kernels.sh
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../kernels
    DEPENDS
        "../kernels/kernelsAll.cu"
        "../kernels/kernels4.cu"
        "../kernels/kernels4Derivatives.cu"
        "../kernels/kernelsX.cu"
        "../kernels/kernelsXDerivatives.cu"
        "../GPUImplDefs.h"
    COMMENT "Generating Metal kernel source strings"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(MetalKernels
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../kernels/BeagleMetal_kernels.h
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared library
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_library(METAL_FRAMEWORK    Metal    REQUIRED)
find_library(FOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK Foundation REQUIRED)

add_definitions(-DFW_METAL -DDLS_MACOS)

add_library(hmsbeagle-metal SHARED
    ../BeagleGPUImpl.h
    ../BeagleGPUImpl.hpp
    ../GPUImplDefs.h
    ../GPUImplHelper.cpp
    ../GPUImplHelper.h
    ../GPUInterfaceMetal.mm
    ../KernelLauncher.cpp
    ../KernelLauncher.h
    ../KernelResource.cpp
    ../KernelResource.h
    ../MetalPlugin.cpp
    ../MetalPlugin.h
    ../Precision.h
)

add_dependencies(hmsbeagle-metal MetalKernels)

# Enable Objective-C++ for .mm sources.
set_source_files_properties(../GPUInterfaceMetal.mm PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_FLAGS "-x objective-c++ -fobjc-arc"
)

target_link_libraries(hmsbeagle-metal
    ${METAL_FRAMEWORK}
    ${FOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK}
)

install(TARGETS hmsbeagle-metal
    DESTINATION ${BEAGLE_INSTALL_DIR}
    COMPONENT metal
)

set_target_properties(hmsbeagle-metal PROPERTIES
    SOVERSION "${BEAGLE_PLUGIN_VERSION_EXTENDED}"
    SUFFIX    "${BEAGLE_PLUGIN_SUFFIX}"
)
